newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Cargill pays 63 mln rand for Carnia Seeds.
newsitem.headline: Cargill pays 63 mln rand for Carnia Seeds.

text.p: South Africa's Omnia Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday that it had sold its seeds business Carnia Seeds to Cargill South Africa for 63 million rand cash.
Carnia produces, processes and distributes maize, wheat, sunflower, sorghum and soybean seed throughout southern Africa. Cargill South Africa is a unit of Cargill Inc of the U.S.
The deal was first announced earlier this month but no financial details were given at the time.
The sale, effective from March 1, will have no material impact on earnings and a beneficial effect on Omnia's balance sheet.
The cash garnered from the sale will be used to reduce borrowings. Assuming the sale had been effective at end-1996, Omnia's debt-equity ratio would have been 41.4 percent instead of 73.3 percent.
